This page lists all endpoints of the [REST API](/docs/api/rest-api), grouped by topic.
Paths are relative to the API base URL, e.g., `http://localhost:3030/api`.
The column _Session_ says whether an endpoint needs a session (_yes_), works with and without one (_optional_), or needs none (_no_); see [Authentication](/docs/api/rest-api#authentication).
The request and response bodies are described in the OpenAPI specification and the Swagger UI of the server.

## Cache

| Method | Path           | Session | Description                                                         |
| ------ | -------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST` | `/cache/clear` | yes     | Clear operator results, STAC query metadata and GDAL worker caches. |

## Datasets

| Method   | Path                                                      | Session | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST`   | `/dataset`                                                | yes     | Creates a new dataset referencing files. Users can reference previously uploaded files. Admins can reference files from a volume.                                               |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/auto`                                           | yes     | Creates a new dataset using previously uploaded files. The format of the files will be automatically detected when possible.                                                    |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/suggest`                                        | yes     | Inspects an upload and suggests metadata that can be used when creating a new dataset based on it. Tries to automatically detect the main file and layer name if not specified. |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/volumes`                                        | yes     | Lists available volumes.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/volumes/{volume_name}/files/{file_name}/layers` | yes     | List the layers of a file in a volume.                                                                                                                                          |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/{dataset}`                                      | yes     | Retrieves details about a dataset using the internal name.                                                                                                                      |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/{dataset}`                                      | yes     | Update details about a dataset using the internal name.                                                                                                                         |
| `DELETE` | `/dataset/{dataset}`                                      | yes     | Delete a dataset                                                                                                                                                                |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/loadingInfo`                          | yes     | Retrieves the loading information of a dataset                                                                                                                                  |
| `PUT`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/loadingInfo`                          | yes     | Updates the dataset's loading info                                                                                                                                              |
| `PUT`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/provenance`                           | yes     | Updates the dataset's provenance.                                                                                                                                               |
| `PUT`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/symbology`                            | yes     | Updates the dataset's symbology                                                                                                                                                 |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/{dataset}/tiles`                                | yes     | Add a tile to a gdal dataset.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `GET`    | `/datasets`                                               | yes     | Lists available datasets.                                                                                                                                                       |

## Layers

| Method   | Path                                                              | Session | Description                                                                                   |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `PUT`    | `/layerDb/collections/{collection}`                               | yes     | Update a collection                                                                           |
| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/collections/{collection}`                               | yes     | Remove a collection                                                                           |
| `POST`   | `/layerDb/collections/{collection}/collections`                   | yes     | Add a new collection to an existing collection                                                |
| `POST`   | `/layerDb/collections/{collection}/layers`                        | yes     | Add a new layer to a collection                                                               |
| `POST`   | `/layerDb/collections/{collection}/layers/{layer}`                | yes     | Add an existing layer to a collection                                                         |
| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/collections/{collection}/layers/{layer}`                | yes     | Remove a layer from a collection                                                              |
| `POST`   | `/layerDb/collections/{parent}/collections/{collection}`          | yes     | Add an existing collection to a collection                                                    |
| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/collections/{parent}/collections/{collection}`          | yes     | Delete a collection from a collection                                                         |
| `PUT`    | `/layerDb/layers/{layer}`                                         | yes     | Update a layer                                                                                |
| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/layers/{layer}`                                         | yes     | Remove a collection                                                                           |
| `GET`    | `/layerDb/providers`                                              | yes     | List all providers                                                                            |
| `POST`   | `/layerDb/providers`                                              | yes     | Add a new provider                                                                            |
| `GET`    | `/layerDb/providers/{provider}`                                   | yes     | Get an existing provider's definition                                                         |
| `PUT`    | `/layerDb/providers/{provider}`                                   | yes     | Update an existing provider's definition                                                      |
| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/providers/{provider}`                                   | yes     | Delete an existing provider                                                                   |
| `GET`    | `/layers/collections`                                             | yes     | List all layer collections                                                                    |
| `GET`    | `/layers/collections/search/autocomplete/{provider}/{collection}` | yes     | Autocompletes the search on the contents of the collection of the given provider              |
| `GET`    | `/layers/collections/search/{provider}/{collection}`              | yes     | Searches the contents of the collection of the given provider                                 |
| `GET`    | `/layers/collections/{provider}/{collection}`                     | yes     | List the contents of the collection of the given provider                                     |
| `GET`    | `/layers/{provider}/capabilities`                                 | yes     | Returns the capabilities of the given provider, e.g., whether it supports listing and search. |
| `GET`    | `/layers/{provider}/{layer}`                                      | yes     | Retrieves the layer of the given provider                                                     |
| `POST`   | `/layers/{provider}/{layer}/dataset`                              | yes     | Persist a raster layer from a provider as a dataset.                                          |
| `POST`   | `/layers/{provider}/{layer}/processingGraphId`                    | yes     | Registers a layer from a provider as a processing graph and returns the processing graph id   |

## Processing Graphs

| Method | Path                                     | Session | Description                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST` | `/datasetFromProcessingGraph/{id}`       | yes     | Create a task for creating a new dataset from the result of the processing graph given by its `id` and the dataset parameters in the request body. Returns the id of the created task |
| `POST` | `/processingGraphs`                      | yes     | Registers a new processing graph.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}`                 | yes     | Retrieves an existing processing graph.                                                                                                                                               |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/allMetadata/zip` | yes     | Gets a ZIP archive of the processing graph, its provenance and the output metadata.                                                                                                   |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/metadata`        | yes     | Gets the result metadata of a processing graph                                                                                                                                        |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/provenance`      | yes     | Gets the provenance of all datasets used in a processing graph.                                                                                                                       |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/rasterStream`    | yes     | Query a processing graph raster result as a stream of tiles via a websocket connection.                                                                                               |

## Projects

| Method   | Path                           | Session | Description                                                                |
| -------- | ------------------------------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST`   | `/project`                     | yes     | Create a new project for the user.                                         |
| `GET`    | `/project/{project}`           | yes     | Retrieves details about the latest version of a project.                   |
| `DELETE` | `/project/{project}`           | yes     | Deletes a project.                                                         |
| `PATCH`  | `/project/{project}`           | yes     | Updates a project. This will create a new version.                         |
| `GET`    | `/project/{project}/versions`  | yes     | Lists all available versions of a project.                                 |
| `GET`    | `/project/{project}/{version}` | yes     | Retrieves details about the given version of a project.                    |
| `GET`    | `/projects`                    | yes     | List all projects accessible to the user that match the selected criteria. |

## Session

| Method | Path                         | Session | Description                                                                                                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `POST` | `/anonymous`                 | no      | Creates session for anonymous user. The session's id serves as a Bearer token for requests.                                                            |
| `POST` | `/login`                     | no      | Creates a session by providing user credentials. The session's id serves as a Bearer token for requests.                                               |
| `POST` | `/logout`                    | yes     | Ends a session.                                                                                                                                        |
| `POST` | `/oidcInit`                  | no      | Initializes the Open Id Connect login procedure by requesting a parametrized url to the configured Id Provider.                                        |
| `POST` | `/oidcLogin`                 | no      | Creates a session for a user via a login with Open Id Connect. This call must be preceded by a call to oidcInit and match the parameters of that call. |
| `GET`  | `/session`                   | yes     | Retrieves details about the current session.                                                                                                           |
| `POST` | `/session/project/{project}` | yes     | Sets the active project of the session.                                                                                                                |
| `POST` | `/session/view`              | yes     | Sets the view (spatial and temporal extent) of the current session.                                                                                    |
| `POST` | `/user`                      | no      | Registers a user.                                                                                                                                      |
